nodes.label: Case Detail Modal - Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.
nodes.description: UI screenshot of a modal dialog in the Captio application (Spanish locale). The modal displays a case/lead record for 'Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.' under the category 'Negocios / contrato'. It shows a status workflow selector with states: Invitado, Nuevo, En revisión (currently selected/highlighted in purple), Consulta agendada, Revisión de conflicto, Cliente aceptado ✓, Rechazado, Cerrado. Below the status section is a 'Respuestas del cliente' (Client Responses) section with a 'Generando...' (Generating...) action button in purple and an 'Eliminar' (Delete) button. A subsection labeled 'Información básica' (Basic Information) is visible at the bottom.
